title: ZTAS-DTh: code and data for a zero-trust security architecture for the digital thread (v1.0.0)
description:
Code, configurations, random seeds, raw and processed data, an executed notebook, bounded model-checking logs and a single-host software proof of concept accompanying the manuscript ZTAS-DTh: A Lifecycle-Spanning Zero-Trust Security Architecture for the Digital Thread — Design, Bounded Formal Analysis, and Simulation-Based Evaluation (submitted to IEEE Transactions on Industrial Informatics).

Contents: paired Monte-Carlo attack-propagation simulation over nine synthetic digital-thread topology families (174,000 simulated attacks) with hierarchical-bootstrap statistics; provenance-verification sensitivity analysis; risk-engine evaluation under six synthetic score distributions; post-quantum (ML-DSA, ML-KEM, SLH-DSA) and classical cryptographic micro-benchmarks with raw timing samples and a batching-latency model; explicit-state bounded model checking with negative controls; proof-of-concept services and results.

Scope: all detection probabilities in the simulation are modelling assumptions and all score distributions are synthetic; benchmarks were measured on a server CPU; no industrial measurement or deployment is included.
